verdict.rationale: Convex's own Convex Auth library is documented as supporting custom sign-up/sign-in flows via social identity providers, one-time email/SMS codes, or passwords. Auth is listed as a feature on the Free/Starter plan, and Convex also documents integrations with Clerk, WorkOS AuthKit, Auth0 and any OIDC provider. The docs scope Convex Auth to client-side React and React Native apps and frame it as building a 'custom' flow, so the 'in minutes' speed is unsupported. missing for 10: evidence of minutes-level setup speed, Convex Auth support beyond React/React Native clients, independent or hands-on corroboration.
